name: When should I hire a general contractor for my remodeling project?
description: Hire a general contractor for complex remodeling projects involving multiple trades or permits.

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor for my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a general contractor when your remodeling project involves multiple trades, requires permits, or is complex. For example, if you're undertaking a kitchen or bathroom remodel, an addition, or a whole-house renovation, a general contractor can ensure proper coordination, compliance with building codes, and efficient project completion. For smaller, single-trade jobs like painting a room, you might not need one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for complex remodeling projects involving multiple trades or permits.
